# Map chlorophyll-a
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Load rasters
rast_winter <- rast("Transparency/C20060322C20243662024366_Chl_comp_DJF_mapped.hdf")
rast_spring <- rast("Transparency/C20060602C20241522024152_Chl_comp_MAM_mapped.hdf")
rast_summer <- rast("Transparency/C20061522C20242442024244_Chl_comp_JJA_mapped.hdf")
rast_fall   <- rast("Transparency/C20062442C20243352024335_Chl_comp_SON_mapped.hdf")

# Define a correction function
correct_raster <- function(r) {
  # Add 200 to values between -100 and -1, leave others unchanged
  r_corrected <- ifel(r >= -128 & r <= -10, r + 256, r)
  return(r_corrected)
}

# Apply correction
rast_winter <- correct_raster(rast_winter)
rast_spring <- correct_raster(rast_spring)
rast_summer <- correct_raster(rast_summer)
rast_fall   <- correct_raster(rast_fall)

#
rast_winter <- clamp(rast_winter[[1]], lower = 10, upper = 254, values = FALSE)
rast_spring <- clamp(rast_spring[[1]], lower = 10, upper = 254, values = FALSE)
rast_summer <- clamp(rast_summer[[1]], lower = 10, upper = 254, values = FALSE)
rast_fall <- clamp(rast_fall[[1]], lower = 10, upper = 254, values = FALSE)


#
crs(rast_winter) <- "EPSG:4326"
crs(rast_spring) <- "EPSG:4326"
crs(rast_summer) <- "EPSG:4326"
crs(rast_fall) <- "EPSG:4326"

#
rast_winter <- terra::project(rast_winter, "EPSG:4326")
rast_spring <- terra::project(rast_spring, "EPSG:4326")
rast_summer <- terra::project(rast_summer, "EPSG:4326")
rast_fall <- terra::project(rast_fall, "EPSG:4326")

#
ext(rast_winter) <- c(-125, -117, 29.5, 35.5)
ext(rast_spring) <- c(-125, -117, 29.5, 35.5)
ext(rast_summer) <- c(-125, -117, 29.5, 35.5)
ext(rast_fall) <- c(-125, -117, 29.5, 35.5)

# Function to flip raster vertically and convert to data frame
raster_to_df <- function(rast, season_name) {
  # Flip raster on y-axis (vertical flip)
  rast_flipped <- flip(rast, direction = "vertical")
  
  # Convert to dataframe
  df <- as.data.frame(rast_flipped, xy = TRUE)
  colnames(df) <- c("Lon", "Lat", "ChlorA")
  df$Season <- season_name
  return(df)
}

# Create dataframes for each season
df_winter <- raster_to_df(rast_winter, "Winter")
df_spring <- raster_to_df(rast_spring, "Spring")
df_summer <- raster_to_df(rast_summer, "Summer")
df_fall   <- raster_to_df(rast_fall, "Fall")

# Combine and apply the transformation
df_all_seasons <- bind_rows(df_winter, df_spring, df_summer, df_fall) %>%
  mutate(ChlorA_scaled = 10**(0.014999999664723873 * ChlorA - 2)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Lon, Lat, Season, ChlorA, ChlorA_scaled) %>%
  distinct()

# 
df_all_seasons <- df_all_seasons %>%
  mutate(
    Lon_rounded = round(Lon, 3),
    Lat_rounded = round(Lat, 3)
  )

# Create california box
california_bbox <- c(xmin = -125, xmax = -117, ymin = 29.5, ymax = 35.5)

# Create color palette
viridis_base <- as.character(paletteer_c("viridis::viridis", 24))

# Add color for higher values
hot_tail <- colorRampPalette(c(
  viridis_base[24],
  "#FDAE61",
  "#D73027"
))(6)

# Create custom color palette
my_palette <- c(viridis_base, hot_tail)

# Create df
df_all_seasons$Season <- factor(df_all_seasons$Season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall"))

# Season shown in the top-left facet
season_topleft <- levels(df_all_seasons$Season)[4]

# North arrow location and size
arrow_x   <- california_bbox["xmin"] + 0.6
arrow_y   <- california_bbox["ymin"] + 0.6

# Define scaling for the rest of the code
scale_all <- 0.6

# Detach package to avoid same name function issue later
detach(package:terra, unload = TRUE)

# Create figure
Fig1Map <- ggplot(df_all_seasons, aes(x = Lon, y = Lat, fill = ChlorA_scaled)) +
  geom_raster() +
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = california_bbox["xmax"] - 2.5,  
      xmax = california_bbox["xmax"] - 0.1,
      ymin = california_bbox["ymax"] - 0.5, 
      ymax = california_bbox["ymax"] - 0.1
    ),
    fill = "tan", color = NA,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  ## north arrow shaft
  geom_segment(
    data = data.frame(Season = season_topleft),
    aes(
      x = arrow_x,
      xend = arrow_x,
      y = arrow_y,
      yend = arrow_y + 0.6
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.4,
    color = "white",
    arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.07, "in"))
  ) +

  ## "N" label
  geom_text(
    data = data.frame(Season = season_topleft),
    aes(
      x = arrow_x,
      y = arrow_y + 0.8 + 0.15,
      label = "N"
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4 * scale_all,
    color = "white"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(. ~ Season) +
  coord_fixed(
    xlim = c(california_bbox["xmin"], california_bbox["xmax"]),
    ylim = c(california_bbox["ymin"], california_bbox["ymax"]),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = my_palette, 
    name = "ChlorA (scaled)",
    trans = "log10"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(y) paste0(y, "°")) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-125, -117, by = 3),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "°")
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "tan"),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 9  * scale_all),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
    strip.text  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7  * scale_all),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9 * scale_all),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.4, "in"),   
    legend.key.height = unit(0.05, "in"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", size = 0.2),
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "gray90",
      color = "black",
      size = 0.2
    ),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.02, "in"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.3)
  )

ggsave("Fig1.png", plot = Fig1Map, units = "in", width = 5, height = 4.25, dpi = 300, device = "png")

```


# Morphological analysis

### Run the PCA 
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Define traits columns
traits_columns <-
  c(
    # Size
    "area",
    "area_filled",
    "axis_major_length",
    "axis_minor_length",
    "equivalent_diameter_area",
    "perimeter_crofton",
    "feret_diameter_max",
    # Shape
    "circularity",
    "elongation",
    # Pixel intensity
    "range",
    "intensity_max",
    "intensity_mean",
    "intensity_std",
    # Complexity
    "perimareaexc",
    "feretareaexc",
    "perimmajor",
    "perimferet", 
    "fractal_dimension"
  )

# Save non scaling data
features_processed_scale <- features_processed

# Scale only traits columns 
features_processed_scale[, traits_columns] <- scale(features_processed_scale[, traits_columns])

# Save non transform data
features_processed_scale_yeo <- features_processed_scale

# Apply Yeo-Johnson Transformation on trait data
features_processed_scale_yeo[, traits_columns] <-
  sapply(features_processed_scale[, traits_columns], function(x)
    yeojohnson(x)$x.t)

# Save final data
features_processed_scale_yeo_norm <- features_processed_scale_yeo

# Run PCA
morpho_pca <- PCA(
  features_processed_scale_yeo_norm[, traits_columns],
  scale.unit = TRUE,
  graph = FALSE
)

# Bind PCA values and other variables
morpho_var_scores <- data.frame(morpho_pca$var$coord)
morpho_ind_scores <- data.frame(morpho_pca$ind$coord)
morpho_ind_scores <- cbind(
  morpho_ind_scores,
  dplyr::select(
    features_processed_scale_yeo_norm,
    objid,
    taxon,
    Line,
    Year,
    Year_month,
    Month,
    Day,
    Station,
    Season,
    BEUTI_day_mean,
    Lon,
    Lat,
    Coast_distance,
    Nitra_depth,
    Temp_C,
    Temp_C_surf,
    O2_mlL,
    O2_mlL_surf,
    Sal_PSU,
    Sal_PSU_surf,
    ChlorA,
    ChlorA_surf,
    area,
    intensity_mean
  )
)

# Extract eigen values
morpho_eig <- data.frame(eigenval = morpho_pca$eig[, 1])
morpho_eig$nb <- seq_along(morpho_eig$eigenval)
morpho_eig$prop <- morpho_eig$eigenval / sum(morpho_eig$eigenval)

# Plot the proportion of variance explained by PCs
ggplot(morpho_eig) + geom_bar(aes(x = nb, y = prop), stat = "identity") +
  geom_line(aes(x = nb, y = mean(prop))) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Eigenvalues") +
  ylab("Proportion") +
  ggtitle("Proportion of Eigenvalues")

```


### Plot morphological space

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Calculate centroids for each taxon 
morpho_taxo_centroids <- morpho_ind_scores %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarise(Dim.1 = mean(Dim.1), Dim.2 = mean(Dim.2), Dim.3 = mean(Dim.3), Dim.4 = mean(Dim.4))

axis_size <- 7

threshold <- 0.15 # Set a threshold for correlation of 15%
filtered_morpho_var_scores_Dim1_Dim2 <-
  morpho_cor_var[apply(morpho_cor_var[, c("Dim.1", "Dim.2")], 1, function(x)
    any(abs(x) > threshold)),]

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 3)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 3)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = taxa_colors,
    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 3, override.aes = list(size = 6))
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = taxa_shapes
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = category_colors, guide = guide_legend(nrow = 4)
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(title = "Trait category", nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE, 
                         override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)
                         ),
    fill = guide_legend(title = NULL, ncol = 6, byrow = FALSE, override.aes = list(shape = shapes_for_legend, size = 1)), 
    shape = "none", size = "none"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9 * scale_all) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 9  * scale_all),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
    strip.text  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7  * scale_all),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9 * scale_all),
    legend.key.height = unit(2, "mm"),
    legend.key.width  = unit(4, "mm"),
    legend.spacing.y  = unit(1, "mm"),
    legend.spacing.x  = unit(1, "mm")
  )+
  geom_text(
    aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = "B"),
    hjust = -0.5,
    vjust = 1.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 7 * scale_all
  )

# Final plot
PCA_morpho_img <- 
  morpho_PC1_PC2_img + morpho_PC3_PC4_img +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    theme = theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "lines")
    )
  )

ggsave("Fig3.png", plot = PCA_morpho_img, units = "in", width = 5, height = 3.5, dpi = 300, device = "png")
```

# Morphological diversity

## Elbow plot
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Matrix 4 dimensions
x <- as.matrix(morpho_ind_scores[, c("Dim.1","Dim.2","Dim.3","Dim.4")])

# Prepare kmeans function
wss_mb <- function(k) {
  mb <- MiniBatchKmeans(
    data = x,
    clusters = k,
    batch_size = 1000,
    max_iters = 1000,
    init_fraction = 0.2,
    initializer = "kmeans++"
  )
  sum(mb$WCSS_per_cluster)
}

# Prepare and run iterations
cluster_range <- seq(50, 800, by = 50)
wss_values <- sapply(cluster_range, wss_mb)

# Prepare df 
wss_df <- data.frame(
  clusters = cluster_range,
  wss = wss_values
)

# Plot Elbow graph
Elbow <- ggplot(wss_df, aes(x = clusters, y = wss)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(color = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(pretty(wss_df$clusters), 400)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 400, color = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Elbow method to select k number of morphotypes",
    x = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y = "Total within‑cluster sum of squares"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14 * scale_all, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 9  * scale_all),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
    strip.text  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", size = 0.2),
    strip.background = element_rect(
    fill = "gray90",
    color = "black",
    size = 0.2),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.02, "in"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.3)
  ) 

ggsave("FigS3.png", plot = Elbow, units = "in", width = 5, height = 3.5, dpi = 300, device = "png")

```

## Compute diversity index
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Set seed
set.seed(123)

# Prepare matrix based on PCA coordinates
x = as.matrix(morpho_ind_scores[, c("Dim.1","Dim.2","Dim.3","Dim.4")])

# Run the Kmeans clustering
mb <- MiniBatchKmeans(
  x,
  clusters = 400,
  batch_size = 1000,
  max_iters = 1000,
  init_fraction = 0.2,
  initializer = "kmeans++"
)

# Attribute morphotypes back to main data
clusters <- predict_MBatchKMeans(x, mb$centroids)
morpho_ind_scores$morphotype_400 <- clusters
morpho_ind_scores$morphotype_label_400 <- clusters
traits_400 <- morpho_ind_scores %>%
  group_by(morphotype_label_400) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("Dim"), mean), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  select(Dim.1, Dim.2, Dim.3, Dim.4, morphotype_label_400) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "morphotype_label_400") %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Create the site-by-morphotype matrix
sp_com_400 <- morpho_ind_scores %>%
  group_by(Year_month, Line, Station, morphotype_label_400) %>%
  summarise(morphotype_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = morphotype_label_400, 
              values_from = morphotype_count, 
              values_fill = list(morphotype_count = 0)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  `rownames<-`(paste(.$Year_month, .$Line, .$Station, sep = "_")) %>%
  select(-Year_month, -Line, -Station) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Diversity metrics computation
richness_400 <- fd_fric(traits_400, sp_com_400, stand = FALSE)
sp_com_pool_400 <- matrix(colSums(sp_com_400), nrow = 1, dimnames = list("SpeciesPool", colnames(sp_com_400)))
FRic_pool_400 <- fd_fric(traits_400, sp_com_pool_400, stand = FALSE)$FRic
richness_400$FRic_normalized <- richness_400$FRic / FRic_pool_400
divergence_400 <- fd_fdiv(traits_400, sp_com_400)
eveness_400 <- fd_feve(traits_400, sp_com_400, dist_matrix = NULL)

# Compute mean values for all variables and merge diversity metrics
morpho_hypervolume <- morpho_ind_scores %>%
  group_by(Year_month, Line, Station, Year, Month, Season, Coast_distance, Lat, Lon) %>%
  summarise(
    BEUTI_day_mean = mean(BEUTI_day_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    Nitra_depth = mean(Nitra_depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    ChlorA = mean(ChlorA, na.rm = TRUE),
    ChlorA_surf = mean(ChlorA_surf, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Temp_C = mean(Temp_C, na.rm = TRUE),
    Temp_C_surf = mean(Temp_C_surf, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sal_PSU = mean(Sal_PSU, na.rm = TRUE),
    Sal_PSU_surf = mean(Sal_PSU_surf, na.rm = TRUE),
    O2_mlL = mean(O2_mlL, na.rm = TRUE),
    O2_mlL_surf = mean(O2_mlL_surf, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim1_mean = mean(Dim.1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim2_mean = mean(Dim.2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim3_mean = mean(Dim.3, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim4_mean = mean(Dim.4, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim1_median = median(Dim.1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim2_median = median(Dim.2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim3_median = median(Dim.3, na.rm = TRUE),
    Dim4_median = median(Dim.4, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  cbind(MRic_400 = richness_400$FRic_normalized, 
        MDiv_400 = divergence_400$FDiv, 
        MEve_400 = eveness_400$FEve
        ) %>%
  mutate(Coast_distance = round(Coast_distance, 1),
         Year_month_date    = ym(Year_month),
         Year_month_numeric = as.numeric(Year_month_date))

```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define reference ID

  distinct(Year_month, Line, Station) %>%
  mutate(ref_id = paste(Year_month, Line, Station, sep = "_"))

# Copepoda_calanoida

  group_by(morphotype_label_400) %>%

  left_join(divergence_400_doliolids %>% select(site, MDiv_400_doliolids = FDiv), by = "site") %>%

  left_join(richness_400_polychaete %>% select(site, MRic_400_polychaete = FRic), by = "site") %>%
  left_join(eveness_400_polychaete %>% select(site, MEve_400_polychaete = FEve), by = "site") %>%
  left_join(divergence_400_polychaete %>% select(site, MDiv_400_polychaete = FDiv), by = "site") %>%
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Create confidence interval function
mean_ci95 <- function(x) {
  m <- mean(x)
  se <- sd(x) / sqrt(length(x))
  t_val <- qt(0.95, df = length(x) - 1)  
  data.frame(y = m, ymin = m - t_val * se, ymax = m + t_val * se)
}
```

### Investigate morphotype 
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Compute the number of unique taxa per morphotype
taxa_per_morphotype <- morpho_ind_scores %>%
  group_by(morphotype_label_400) %>%
  summarise(num_taxa = n_distinct(taxon), .groups = "drop")

#
summary_stats <- taxa_per_morphotype %>%
  summarise(
    mean_taxa = mean(num_taxa),
    median_taxa = median(num_taxa),
    min_taxa = min(num_taxa),
    max_taxa = max(num_taxa),
    sd_taxa = sd(num_taxa)
  )

print(summary_stats)


# Compute contributions
taxa_contrib_filtered <- morpho_ind_scores %>%
  group_by(morphotype_label_400, taxon) %>%
  summarise(taxon_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(morphotype_label_400) %>%
  mutate(total_count = sum(taxon_count),
         relative_contribution = 100 * taxon_count / total_count) %>%
  filter(relative_contribution > 5) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Get top 3 taxa by contribution for each morphotype
top3_taxa <- morpho_ind_scores %>%
  group_by(morphotype_label_400, taxon) %>%
  summarise(taxon_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(morphotype_label_400) %>%
  mutate(total_count = sum(taxon_count),
         relative_contribution = 100 * taxon_count / total_count) %>%
  arrange(desc(relative_contribution)) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = relative_contribution, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create separate data frames
rank1 <- top3_taxa %>% filter(rank == 1)
rank2 <- top3_taxa %>% filter(rank == 2)
rank3 <- top3_taxa %>% filter(rank == 3)

# Count dominant morphotypes per taxon for each rank
count_per_rank <- function(data, rank_label) {
  data %>%
    count(taxon, name = "n_morphotypes") %>%
    mutate(rank = rank_label)
}

df_rank1 <- count_per_rank(rank1, "1st")
df_rank2 <- count_per_rank(rank2, "2nd")
df_rank3 <- count_per_rank(rank3, "3rd")

# Combine all ranks
combined_counts <- bind_rows(df_rank1, df_rank2, df_rank3)

# Plot
ggplot(combined_counts, aes(x = reorder(taxon, n_morphotypes), y = n_morphotypes, fill = rank)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  labs(x = "Taxon", y = "Number of morphotypes (400)", fill = "Rank of contribution") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal()

```

### Coast distance
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Load df MODIFY PATH WHEN DATA ARE AVAILABLE ONLINE
abd_data_sum <-
  read.csv(
    "data/abundance_biomasse_data.csv")

# Define a proper scale for
fill_scale <- scale_fill_manual(values = taxa_colors)

# Define text names
dat_text_A_B <- data.frame(
  label = c("A", "B"),
  Line   = c(80, 90)
)
dat_text_C_D <- data.frame(
  label = c("C", "D"),
  Line   = c(80, 90)
)

# Define proper order
abd_data_sum$Taxa <- factor(abd_data_sum$Taxa, levels = ordered_taxa)

# Abundance vs Coast distance
row1 <- ggplot(abd_data_sum, aes(x = Coast_distance, y = Abundance, fill = Taxa)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(Line ~ ., scales = "fixed", nrow = 1, labeller = labeller(Line = c("80" = "Line 80", "90" = "Line 90"))) +
  scale_x_reverse(
  breaks = c(0, 50, 100, 200, 400, 600),
  limits = c(600, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) {
      sapply(x, function(y) {
        if (is.na(y)) return(NA)
        if (y == 0) return("0") 
        expo <- floor(log10(abs(y)))
        base <- y / 10^expo
        bquote(.(round(base, 2)) %*% 10^.(expo))
      })
    },
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  fill_scale +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = expression("Abundance (Ind. "~m^{-2}~")"), x = NULL) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text   = element_text(size = 9  * scale_all),
    axis.title  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all),
    strip.text  = element_text(size = 10 * scale_all, margin = margin(t = 1, b = 1)),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7 * scale_all),
```

# GAM Models

### Modeling
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Load same df with El Nino and Transparency variables MODIFY PATH WHEN DATA ARE AVAILABLE ONLINE
morpho_hypervolume_var <-
  read.csv(
    "data/morpho_hypervolume_var.csv")

# Delete lines with NA
morpho_hypervolume_var <- morpho_hypervolume_var %>%
  drop_na("Sal_PSU", "Temp_C", "O2_mlL", "ChlorA")

# Make 
morpho_hypervolume_var$Year <- as.numeric(morpho_hypervolume_var$Year)

# Check correlation
cor(morpho_hypervolume_var[, c("Sal_PSU", "Temp_C", "O2_mlL", "ChlorA", "Year", "Coast_distance", 
                                 "El_nino3.4", "Transparency", "MRic_400"
                                 )], method = "spearman")

# Define reference category for season
morpho_hypervolume_var$Season <- relevel(
  factor(morpho_hypervolume_var$Season),
  ref = "Winter"
)

# Transform data to log for normality
morpho_hypervolume_var$ChlorA_transform <- log(morpho_hypervolume_var$ChlorA)

#
morpho_hypervolume_var$Station <- as.factor(morpho_hypervolume_var$Station)
morpho_hypervolume_var$Year <- substr(morpho_hypervolume_var$Year_month, 1, 4)
morpho_hypervolume_var$Year <- as.integer(morpho_hypervolume_var$Year)

#
morpho_hypervolume_var <- morpho_hypervolume_var %>%
  mutate(
    Season = factor(Season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall"))
  )
#
morpho_hypervolume_var$Nino_q <- cut(
  morpho_hypervolume_var$El_nino3.4,
  breaks = c(-Inf, -1, 1, Inf),
  labels = c("La Nina", "Neutral", "El Nino")
)

#
morpho_hypervolume_var$Season_Line <- interaction(
  morpho_hypervolume_var$Season,
  morpho_hypervolume_var$Line,
  drop = TRUE
)

#
morpho_hypervolume_var$Nino_q <- relevel(morpho_hypervolume_var$Nino_q, ref = "Neutral")
morpho_hypervolume_var$Line <- as.factor(morpho_hypervolume_var$Line)

#
mega_gam_rich <- gam(
  MRic_400 ~
    s(Year, by = Line) +
    s(Coast_distance, by = Line) +
    s(Temp_C) +
    s(ChlorA_transform) +
    s(Sal_PSU) +
    s(Transparency) +
    Nino_q +
    Season + Line + Season:Line,
  data   = morpho_hypervolume_var,
  select = "TRUE",
  method = "REML"
)
k.check(mega_gam_rich)
summary(mega_gam_rich)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
gam.check(mega_gam_rich)
concurvity(mega_gam_rich, full = FALSE)

###

  MEve_400 ~
    s(Year, by = Line) +
    s(Coast_distance, by = Line) +

    s(ChlorA_transform) +
    s(Sal_PSU) +
    s(Transparency) +
    Nino_q +
    Season + Line + Season:Line,
  data   = morpho_hypervolume_var,

)

# Variance explained for each parameter
gam_hp_rich <- gam.hp(mega_gam_rich)
```

### Prepare model graph
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Helper to get min/max from visreg for a variable
get_visreg_range <- function(model, var, by = "Line", breaks = NULL) {
  p <- visreg(model, var, by = by, overlay = TRUE, breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)
  
  visreg_data <- data.frame(
    x = p$fit[[var]],
    fit = p$fit$visregFit,
    lwr = p$fit$visregLwr,
    upr = p$fit$visregUpr
  )
  
  # Apply special rule for Coast_distance: ignore min values after 400 km
  if (var == "Coast_distance") {
    visreg_data <- visreg_data %>%
      mutate(fit_for_range = ifelse(x > 400, NA, fit),
             lwr_for_range = ifelse(x > 400, NA, lwr))
    range_vals <- range(c(visreg_data$fit_for_range, visreg_data$lwr_for_range, visreg_data$upr), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    range_vals <- range(c(visreg_data$fit, visreg_data$lwr, visreg_data$upr), na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  range_vals
}
# Variables to check
vars <- c("Year", "Coast_distance", "Season")
# Compute combined y-axis range across all variables
PC1_ylim <- range(sapply(vars, function(v) get_visreg_range(mega_gam_PC1, v)), na.rm = TRUE)
PC2_ylim <- range(sapply(vars, function(v) get_visreg_range(mega_gam_PC2, v)), na.rm = TRUE)
PC3_ylim <- range(sapply(vars, function(v) get_visreg_range(mega_gam_PC3, v)), na.rm = TRUE)
Rich_ylim <- range(sapply(vars, function(v) get_visreg_range(mega_gam_rich, v)), na.rm = TRUE)
Eve_ylim <- range(sapply(vars, function(v) get_visreg_range(mega_gam_eve, v)), na.rm = TRUE)
Div_ylim <- range(sapply(vars, function(v) get_visreg_range(mega_gam_div, v)), na.rm = TRUE)

```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
p <- visreg(mega_gam_rich, "Year", by = "Line", overlay = TRUE, breaks = 3, gg = TRUE)
# Style
for (i in seq_along(p$layers)) {
  if (inherits(p$layers[[i]]$geom, "GeomPolygon")) {

# Add your own custom summary points / CIs
plot_rich_year <- p +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2015, xmax = 2016, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.7) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2023, xmax = 2024, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "darkgrey", alpha = 0.7) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2020, xmax = 2022, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey", alpha = 0.3) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2011, xmax = 2012, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey", alpha = 0.3) +
  aes(color = factor(Line), fill = factor(Line), linetype = factor(Line)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_ci95, geom = "linerange", size = 0.1, alpha = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "CalCOFI Lines", values = c("80" = "#4E79A7", "90" = "#E15759")) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "CalCOFI Lines", values = c("80" = "#4E79A7", "90" = "#E15759")) +
```

#### Coast distance
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# compute observed ranges
mf <- model.frame(mega_gam_rich)
mf$Line <- as.character(mf$Line)
mins <- tapply(mf$Coast_distance, mf$Line, min, na.rm = TRUE)
maxs <- tapply(mf$Coast_distance, mf$Line, max, na.rm = TRUE)
# build visreg plot
p <- visreg(mega_gam_rich, "Coast_distance", by = "Line", overlay = TRUE, breaks = 3, gg = TRUE)
# inline clipping for each layer's data
for (i in seq_along(p$layers)) {
  df <- p$layers[[i]]$data
  if (!is.data.frame(df) || !"Line" %in% names(df)) next
  xcol <- if ("x" %in% names(df)) "x" else if ("Coast_distance" %in% names(df)) "Coast_distance" else next
  idx <- as.character(df$Line)
  keep <- !is.na(mins[idx]) & df[[xcol]] >= mins[idx] & df[[xcol]] <= maxs[idx]
  p$layers[[i]]$data <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}
# Style
for (i in seq_along(p$layers)) {
  if (inherits(p$layers[[i]]$geom, "GeomPolygon")) {
    p$layers[[i]]$aes_params$colour <- NA   # no outline
    p$layers[[i]]$aes_params$size   <- 0    # optional, remove stroke
  }
}
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
base_y <- y_max
y_positions <- base_y + bracket_gap * seq_len(3)
plot_rich_season <- plot_rich_season +
  # Fall significance for Line 80
  geom_signif(
    comparisons = list(c("Winter", "Fall")),
    annotations = "**",

    tip_length = 0.01,

    vjust = 0.6, 
    size = 0.1,
    color = "black"
  )

                                           axis.text.x = element_blank())

                                           axis.text.x = element_blank())

                                           axis.text.x = element_blank())

                                           axis.text.x = element_blank())

plot_PC1_season  <- plot_PC1_season  + coord_cartesian(ylim = PC1_ylim)
plot_PC2_season  <- plot_PC2_season  + coord_cartesian(ylim = PC2_ylim)
plot_PC3_season  <- plot_PC3_season  + coord_cartesian(ylim = PC3_ylim)
plot_rich_season  <- plot_rich_season  + coord_cartesian(ylim = Rich_ylim)
plot_eve_season  <- plot_eve_season  + coord_cartesian(ylim = Eve_ylim)
plot_div_season  <- plot_div_season  + coord_cartesian(ylim = Div_ylim)

# Combine plots with headers
GAM_Season <- 
   (plot_PC1_season / plot_PC2_season / plot_PC3_season) | (plot_rich_season / plot_eve_season / plot_div_season)

ggsave("Fig6.png", plot = GAM_Season, units = "in", width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300, device = "png")
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
    fontface = "bold",
```
